November employment report (Friday) and Fed rate trajectory amid persistent inflation concerns

items.title: Connecticut senator Chris Murphy hospitalized after stroke
items.feedTitle: Connecticut senator Chris Murphy hospitalized after stroke
items.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy (D-Conn.), 53, was hospitalized after suffering a stroke while attending his son's hockey game on Saturday. His office said he is "awake and alert" and expected to make a full recovery. Murphy is a fierce Trump critic who is not up for re-election in the midterms, according to reports.

items.title: Democrats show strength in final days before midterm elections
items.feedTitle: Democrats Show Strength in Final Days of Race for the Senate, New Polls Find
items.summary: New polls released over the weekend show Democrats leading in nearly all key Senate races as the nation heads into Tuesday's midterm elections. Multiple forecasting partners predict Democrats will "likely" win back the House, with control of the Senate also in play. The final weekend of campaigning is underway across competitive districts.

items.title: Halloween weekend shootings kill at least six nationwide
items.feedTitle: Shootings over Halloween weekend leave at least 6 dead and dozens injured across U.S.
items.summary: A series of shootings across the United States over Halloween weekend left at least six people dead and dozens injured. The deadliest violence occurred in Dallas' Deep Ellum neighborhood, where four people were killed and 15 injured in multiple incidents. Additional shootings were reported in Boulder, Colorado; Bloomington, Illinois; and other cities.

items.title: Business jet crashes in Florida, killing all nine on board
items.feedTitle: Jet crashes in Florida, killing all 9 on board
items.summary: A business jet traveling from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas crashed near West Palm Beach, Florida, killing all nine people aboard. The aircraft erupted in a massive fireball near a busy roadway. The Federal Aviation Administration is investigating the cause of the crash.

items.title: Evacuations ordered as Southwest storms intensify flooding
items.feedTitle: Evacuations ordered as weekend storms pound Arizona
items.summary: Communities across Arizona and the Southwest braced for severe flooding as a "pineapple express" weather system brought heavy rainfall to the region over the weekend. Evacuation orders were issued in multiple areas as rivers and streams threatened to overflow. The storms follow weeks of devastating weather in the Four Corners region.

stlouis.title: Amendment 3 puts Missouri abortion access in doubt
stlouis.feedTitle: Amendment 3 puts abortion access in doubt
stlouis.summary: St. Louis area voters are weighing Amendment 3 on Tuesday's ballot, which would determine the future of abortion access in Missouri. The measure is one of the most consequential votes before St. Louis and Missouri residents as midterm elections take place. The outcome will significantly impact reproductive rights in the state.

stlouis.title: St. Louis man charged after fatal police pursuit crash
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis man in custody after fatal crash during police chase
stlouis.summary: A St. Louis man has been arrested and charged in connection with a fatal crash that occurred during a police pursuit. One person was killed and several others injured when a vehicle fleeing police collided with other vehicles. The incident highlights ongoing public safety concerns in the St. Louis area.

stlouis.title: St. Louis prepares Olympic bid with downtown redevelopment
stlouis.feedTitle: Move over, LA: St. Louis gears up for Olympics, invests millions in downtown redevelopment
stlouis.summary: St. Louis is gearing up to compete for the Olympic Games and has announced millions of dollars in investment in downtown redevelopment. The city is positioning itself as a viable alternative to other bidding cities and hopes the Olympic project will transform its urban core. Infrastructure improvements and venue construction are underway.

items.title: Spain train crash kills 69, including four US citizens
items.feedTitle: Spain train crash: US, Japan and Canada citizens among dead, authorities say
items.summary: A high-speed train collision in Spain killed 69 people, including four US citizens and nationals from Canada, Japan, Argentina, Mexico, Tunisia, and the Czech Republic. The disaster marks one of Europe's deadliest rail incidents this century. Among the dead was Dr. Marta Shahbazi, a University of Cambridge scientist recognized for excellence in developmental biology.

items.title: Ukraine's Kherson civilians brace as ceasefire ends
items.feedTitle: Civilians in Ukraine’s Kherson prepare for the return of war as localized ceasefire ends
items.summary: Civilians in Ukraine's Kherson region are preparing for renewed military operations as a rare six-day humanitarian ceasefire ended. The temporary truce allowed evacuations from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, where residents had endured months without food, water, or electricity. Russian strikes have since resumed across other parts of the country.

items.title: Netanyahu urges Trump to strike Iran after US midterms
items.feedTitle: Netanyahu urges Trump to strike Iran immediately after US midterms during 'very good' phone call: Report
items.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu reportedly urged President Trump during a phone call to strike Iran immediately following the US midterm elections on Tuesday. Netanyahu's call suggested optimal timing after the elections to avoid domestic political complications. Trump's response and timeline for potential military action remain unclear, though Gulf states fear escalation could trigger a wider regional war.

items.title: Ukraine's air raid alert app hacked, false warnings sent
items.feedTitle: Ukraine says public air raid alert app sent false alerts after being hacked
items.summary: Ukraine's public air raid warning application was compromised and sent false radiation threat alerts to users. Hours later, Russian authorities reported that their emergency alert app was also hacked with similar fake warnings. Both countries are investigating the coordinated cyberattacks targeting civilian warning systems.

items.title: Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3 billion hack
items.feedTitle: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
items.summary: The FBI has identified North Korea as responsible for a record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency heist at Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange. The attack is tied to a state-sponsored entity known as TraderTraitor, blamed for previous breaches. Binance says it will cover 90 percent of customer losses and has resumed withdrawals after recovering about $3 billion in affected assets.

items.title: INDIA bloc holds massive Delhi rally over voter roll concerns
items.feedTitle: Indian opposition alleges 'vote theft' and warns election chief at massive anti-government rally in Delhi
items.summary: India's opposition alliance staged a large demonstration at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan to protest alleged "vote theft" and irregularities in the voter rolls. Congress and allied parties called for the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner after the Modi government removed 130 million names from voter registries. Thousands of supporters from across the country attended the show of unity against the ruling party.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu strengthens, targets Tamil Nadu coast
items.feedTitle: ‘Murasu’ strengthens into Severe Cyclonic Storm
items.summary: Severe Cyclonic Storm Murasu is moving northwestward toward the south Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu coasts, bringing very heavy rainfall and threatening flooding. Schools and colleges in Chennai and Tiruvallur have been closed on November 2 due to expected heavy rains. The system is the second cyclone to impact India's east coast in less than seven days.

items.title: India's first indigenous bullet train undergoes safety testing
items.feedTitle: India’s first indigenous bullet train on track, undergoes ‘squeeze test’
items.summary: India's first domestically-manufactured bullet train completed a "squeeze test" as it advances toward service. The B28 model is designed to operate at speeds of 280 km/h with a capacity of 557 passengers across eight coaches. The train represents a major milestone in India's rail modernization and reducing dependence on foreign technology.

items.title: India's voter-roll purge backlash intensifies amid Modi scrutiny
items.feedTitle: India’s Voter-Roll Purge Is Coming Back to Haunt Modi
items.summary: The Modi government's removal of 130 million names from voter rolls—claimed to be duplicates and ineligible entries—has ignited major opposition backlash and raised international concern. Critics allege systematic disenfranchisement, though officials maintain the purge is routine maintenance. The controversy has become a central election issue with legal challenges pending.

items.title: Telangana CM attacks PM Modi in INDIA bloc campaign
items.feedTitle: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy likens PM Modi to ‘Ravana’ and Congress to ‘Vanara Sena’
items.summary: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy likened Prime Minister Modi to "Ravana" and compared Congress to "Vanara Sena" at the opposition's massive Delhi rally. The rhetoric reflects the escalating political temperature as opposition parties unite against the ruling BJP ahead of state elections. Reddy accused the Modi government of conspiring to delete 20 crore votes.

immigration.title: DHS ends automatic EAD extensions for certain visa holders
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: On October 30, DHS published an interim final rule (IFR) ending the automatic extension of employment authorization documents (EAD, Form I-766) for aliens who timely filed renewal applications in certain employment-based categories. This change, finalized and in effect, will impact H-1B holders, L-1 visa holders, and others seeking to maintain work authorization during processing delays. Applicants must now request extensions explicitly rather than relying on automatic renewal provisions.

immigration.title: DHS proposes removing deference to prior USCIS visa approvals
immigration.feedTitle: Removing Deference to Prior USCIS Determinations of Eligibility
immigration.summary: DHS proposed a rule to remove 8 CFR 214.1(c)(5), which currently directs USCIS to give deference to prior approvals involving the same facts when adjudicating extension requests. This proposed (not final) change would allow USCIS to re-examine eligibility even when an applicant's circumstances have not materially changed, affecting H-1B and other employment visa holders renewing petitions. The rule is still pending final adoption.

immigration.title: State Department targets birth tourism with new visa restrictions
immigration.feedTitle: Protecting the Sanctity of U.S. Citizenship: A New Visa Restriction Policy for Those Who Engage in or Facilitate Birth Tourism
immigration.summary: The State Department announced a new visa restriction policy targeting individuals who engage in or facilitate birth tourism—the practice of entering the US to give birth to secure citizenship for children. The policy is finalized and in effect, affecting visa applicants from countries identified as sources of birth tourism activity, including China and certain African nations. Consular officers are instructed to scrutinize visa applications in these categories.

items.title: Tech selloff wipes out $5 trillion in AI stock value
items.feedTitle: Stock futures open a monster week after a $5 trillion AI wipeout
items.summary: US stock markets experienced a severe correction as technology stocks, particularly AI-related companies, suffered massive losses amid concerns about return on investment. The S&P 500, Nasdaq, and other indices fell sharply as investors questioned whether billions in AI spending could generate returns quickly enough. Futures rose modestly heading into Monday as markets brace for midterm elections and earnings season.

items.title: Binance crypto exchange loses $3.6 billion in post-hack withdrawals
items.feedTitle: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after record crypto hack
items.summary: Following the FBI's attribution of a record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency heist to North Korea, Binance users withdrew $3.64 billion as the exchange resumed withdrawals. The hack, attributed to the state-sponsored TraderTraitor group, is the largest cryptocurrency theft in history. Binance says it will cover 90 percent of losses, having recovered about $3 billion in frozen assets so far.

items.title: Indian stock markets face tech selloff and FPI withdrawal pressure
items.feedTitle: Stock Market Today: Gift Nifty, Tech Stocks Selloff To Oil Prices; Five Key Factors For Sensex, Nifty 50 On Nov 2
items.summary: Nifty 50 and Sensex indices face headwinds from global tech stock declines and foreign portfolio investor (FPI) concerns over AI market overvaluation. FPIs have turned net buyers in recent sessions as broader market allocation shifts away from concentrated AI trades. Market analysts point to Nifty's 23,200 resistance level as key for determining whether the rally can extend toward 23,500 or higher in coming weeks.

items.title: Oil prices drop amid Iran war talks and market uncertainty
items.feedTitle: Oil Prices Drop 1% as Iran War Talks Continue | Market Update
items.summary: Oil prices fell 1 percent as indirect talks between the US and Iran over reopening the Strait of Hormuz continued. The decline reflects easing tension from earlier threats of military escalation. However, shipping remains at risk in the Persian Gulf region, and geopolitical uncertainty continues to influence commodity markets as investors monitor potential policy shifts after Tuesday's US midterms.

items.title: Affordability dominance drives final election sprint for voters
items.feedTitle: Affordability top of mind for voters in final sprint to midterms: ‘I have to pick between medicine or groceries’
items.summary: Cost of living has emerged as the dominant issue in the final days before the midterm elections, with workers and unions championing candidates fighting for higher wages and relief from rising prices. Polling data shows voters are torn between purchasing medicine and groceries, signaling sustained economic pressure despite recent GDP growth. Both parties are centering their closing messages on addressing inflation and household budgets.

finance.note: Stock futures rose modestly heading into Monday after a brutal week for tech stocks, with the S&P 500, Nasdaq, and AI-heavy indices losing roughly $5 trillion in value as investors questioned return on investment from massive AI spending. Oil prices dropped 1% amid ongoing Iran-US indirect negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, though geopolitical risks remain elevated. Watch: US midterm election results on Tuesday, which could reshape fiscal and regulatory policy; November jobs report due Friday; and earnings season acceleration, particularly from mega-cap tech firms whose guidance will signal confidence in AI infrastructure investments.

cards.title: Automate Your Savings Before You Spend
cards.insight: The behavioral gap between intention and action is why automatic transfers work better than willpower. Set up recurring transfers to savings accounts immediately after paycheck arrival, treating savings like a non-negotiable bill.
cards.takeaway: Open a separate high-yield savings account and automate a fixed amount to transfer on payday—start with 5–10% of gross income and increase yearly.

cards.title: Your EAD Renewal Risk Just Increased
cards.insight: DHS rules ending automatic EAD extensions mean H-1B, L-1, and other visa holders must now actively request extensions rather than relying on passive renewal. Missing deadlines could trigger work authorization gaps. Review your current authorization document status and filing deadlines immediately.
cards.takeaway: If you hold an employment-based visa, contact your immigration attorney now to confirm filing deadlines for renewal applications—do not assume your authorization will extend automatically.

cards.title: Affordability Is Dominating Your Paycheck Choices
cards.insight: Polls show voters are making hard trade-offs between medicine and groceries, signaling real household budget pressure despite reported economic growth. This pattern suggests wage growth is lagging inflation, and higher-income earners need to factor rising living costs into negotiation leverage.
cards.takeaway: Review your last three months of grocery, utilities, and healthcare spending; use these benchmarks to negotiate salary increases or evaluate job switches offering cost-of-living adjustments.

cards.title: Crypto Contagion Risk Remains Real After $6.3B Binance Hack
cards.insight: The largest cryptocurrency theft in history—traced to North Korea—wiped $3.6 billion in user confidence at a single exchange within days, even as the platform covered 90% of losses. Concentration risk in any single custodian is acute; diversification across multiple platforms or self-custody offers protection but requires discipline.
cards.takeaway: If you hold cryptocurrency, audit your holdings across platforms; consider moving significant positions to hardware wallets or splitting across multiple regulated custodians rather than concentrating on one exchange.

ai.title: Parents sue OpenAI after ChatGPT gave dangerous medical advice
ai.feedTitle: Parents of woman who died of seizure after ChatGPT misguidance sue OpenAI
ai.summary: The parents of a woman who died from an epileptic seizure have sued OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT provided dangerous medical advice leading to her death. The woman, who was on anti-seizure medication, reportedly followed the chatbot's instructions to taper her dosage without medical supervision. The lawsuit is one of several challenging AI companies' liability for harmful outputs and marks escalating legal accountability in the sector.

ai.title: Anthropic warns AI could erase entry-level jobs ahead of IPO
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic is heading to Wall Street — its CEO warns AI could erase entry-level jobs
ai.summary: As Anthropic prepares for its Wall Street IPO, CEO Dario Amodei warned that artificial intelligence could eliminate entry-level positions in many industries. The warning comes as the company values itself at up to $100 billion, though investors are becoming more skeptical of AI spending returns. Anthropic's public warnings about AI's societal impacts represent an unusual posture for a company seeking massive capital injections.

ai.title: OpenAI proposes rebranding data centers as 'compute campuses
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Would Reportedly Like You to Use Its Pleasant New Term for Data Centers
ai.summary: OpenAI is reportedly pushing for data centers to be called "compute campuses," a rebrand that aims to soften the image of energy-intensive infrastructure. The company argues the term better reflects the facility's role in AI development. Critics note the proposal reflects data centers' unpopularity due to environmental concerns and suggests semantic framing may be used to ease public resistance to expansion.

ai.title: Anthropic updates Claude to block video game recreation
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic Updates Claude To Stop It From Recreating Existing Video Games
ai.summary: Anthropic deployed restrictions in Claude to prevent the AI from recreating existing video games or reverse-engineering game code. The update also blocks basic troubleshooting and legitimate development tasks, drawing criticism from developers who say the sweeping safeguards are overly broad. The move reflects Anthropic's effort to prevent copyright infringement while balancing legitimate use cases.

ai.title: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10 billion amid investor jitters
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Cuts Funding Target by $10 Billion as Investor Jitters Shake AI Markets
ai.summary: OpenAI has reduced its latest funding round target by $10 billion, now seeking $60 billion instead of $70 billion as investor confidence in AI spending returns wavers. The cut reflects mounting concerns about AI companies' negative cash flows, rising debt, and uncertainty about when AI infrastructure investments will generate meaningful profits. The pullback signals growing skepticism in venture and institutional funding circles.
